WITH store_keys AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT s_store_sk,
           s_store_name,
           s_company_id,
           s_street_number,
           s_street_name,
           s_street_type,
           s_suite_number,
           s_city,
           s_county,
           s_state,
           s_zip
    FROM store
),
august_returns AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT sr.sr_ticket_number,
           sr.sr_item_sk,
           sr.sr_customer_sk,
           d2.d_date AS return_date
    FROM date_dim d2
    JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
    WHERE d2.d_year = 2001
      AND d2.d_moy = 8
),
store_summaries AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT ss.ss_store_sk,
           SUM(CASE WHEN (ar.return_date - d1.d_date) <= 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "30 days",
           SUM(CASE WHEN (ar.return_date - d1.d_date) > 30 AND (ar.return_date - d1.d_date) <= 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "31-60 days",
           SUM(CASE WHEN (ar.return_date - d1.d_date) > 60 AND (ar.return_date - d1.d_date) <= 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "61-90 days",
           SUM(CASE WHEN (ar.return_date - d1.d_date) > 90 AND (ar.return_date - d1.d_date) <= 120 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "91-120 days",
           SUM(CASE WHEN (ar.return_date - d1.d_date) > 120 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ">120 days"
    FROM august_returns ar
    JOIN store_sales ss
      ON ss.ss_ticket_number = ar.sr_ticket_number
     AND ss.ss_item_sk = ar.sr_item_sk
     AND ss.ss_customer_sk = ar.sr_customer_sk
    JOIN date_dim d1 ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
    GROUP BY ss.ss_store_sk
)
SELECT sk.s_store_name,
       sk.s_company_id,
       sk.s_street_number,
       sk.s_street_name,
       sk.s_street_type,
       sk.s_suite_number,
       sk.s_city,
       sk.s_county,
       sk.s_state,
       sk.s_zip,
       SUM(su."30 days") AS "30 days",
       SUM(su."31-60 days") AS "31-60 days",
       SUM(su."61-90 days") AS "61-90 days",
       SUM(su."91-120 days") AS "91-120 days",
       SUM(su.">120 days") AS ">120 days"
FROM store_keys sk
JOIN store_summaries su ON sk.s_store_sk = su.ss_store_sk
GROUP BY sk.s_store_name,
         sk.s_company_id,
         sk.s_street_number,
         sk.s_street_name,
         sk.s_street_type,
         sk.s_suite_number,
         sk.s_city,
         sk.s_county,
         sk.s_state,
         sk.s_zip
ORDER BY sk.s_store_name,
         sk.s_company_id,
         sk.s_street_number,
         sk.s_street_name,
         sk.s_street_type,
         sk.s_suite_number,
         sk.s_city,
         sk.s_county,
         sk.s_state,
         sk.s_zip
LIMIT 100
